note: Item 23k, descriptive. Fiscal 2024 dollars (CPI-U headline; HECA rows in sector_payers.csv as the check). The payer-view gap is spending less the college's own earned income, with student grants moved to the government that paid them; item 15's frozen gap is kept alongside. Gifts are donors and alumni together. Local property-tax exemption is unmeasured (no national or per-college source).
for-profit note: For-profit colleges use the same federal channels as the other sectors (appropriations and student grants, plus the default estimate as a memo). Tuition paid with federal loans stays in their own earned income, so their federal share reads lower than the Department's 90/10 revenue share, which counts loans.
